title: kramastotra — kram-p15-v15
question: Before, emission dissolved, fire-made — where would it shine, facing beyond-joy? It goes, moon-touch-lovely, sharing fire-moon-expanse-both-power. O Bhairava Lord — may this emission-named of Yours sport always in my mind.
